prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1415; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision involving your insured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and confirmation of any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, vehicle data and telematics records, dashcam or surveillance footage, repair and total-loss estimates, recorded statements, and any communications with third parties. Destruction, alteration, or loss of such material may result in serious consequences in any subsequent litigation.

Please acknowledge receipt of this letter and confirm within fourteen days that a claim has been opened and that the requested preservation steps have been taken. We look forward to your prompt response.
